entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand. Just give me the authorization number.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, David. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 18 days ago. Just for my notes, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. The whole interface is just... confusing. It feels hard to use. I've read the user manual, and honestly, I expected more customization. I just want to return it.

I understand, and I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. I can see you're a VIP member with us, and we definitely want you to be happy. Are you sure I can't walk you through setting up a custom dashboard? It often helps.
Look, I don't have time for a tutorial. I'm busy. Can I return it, yes or no?
Yes, of course. My apologies. Let me just verify the return eligibility based on the delivery date. One moment.
Okay, I've checked the policy. You're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you right now.
Great. Thank you. What's the next step?

I have just approved the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Your Return Authorization number is VF-881-2026. As a courtesy for you being a VIP customer, I've also waived any potential restocking fees.
Okay, I see the email. That's perfect. I appreciate that.
You're very welcome, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
